name: Frame HUD overlay
purpose: Persistent viewfinder frame: corner brackets, four micro labels (title, counter, section, credit) and a progress rule, kept above scenes and transitions so cuts feel like one continuous piece.

inputs.name: progress
inputs.description: Show a progress rule under the safe area

implementation.api: Studio.comp.frameHud(parent, {tl, tr, bl, br}, {progress, brackets}) -> {enter(tl, at), set(tl, corner, text, at), progress(tl, from, to), exit(tl, at)}

layout_notes: Pinned to the format's safe-area corners (--safe-*), z-index above the transition overlay; labels use the kicker size (at the 2.6% text floor). In portrait the bottom labels sit above the caption/UI zone because the safe bottom inset is 20%.
validation_steps: python scripts/frame-review.py <project> --fonts google (labels must not collide with scene text in any format)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (label swap, progress fill tracks time, stays visible above a bloom) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
